description: This file defines a mock class 'ControllerMock' implementing the 'IController' interface for testing purposes within the 'rialto::servermanager::ipc' namespace. It includes mock methods for client creation, removal, configuration, state, ping, and log level setting.

classes.name: ControllerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IController interface for unit testing.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Mocks the removal of a client identified by an integer ID.

methods.description: Mocks setting the configuration for a session server with various parameters.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Mocks setting the state of a session server.
